**New here:** built around hiding; a boss you befriend by waving (hold Listen + Kick).

## Main path (Jump 2 / Speed 2: steps <= 2 tiles up, gaps <= 3 tiles)

1. From bas-furnace, crawl the 3-tile gap behind the furnace into lair-gap (save crack + Ready card with the golden-eye portrait).
2. dragon-lair: three phases (LAIRS.barty), reward the Cellophane Cloak.

## Notes

- Needs the Glow Bead (lair-gap is dark) and the Thimble (to reach the Basement at all).
- Music: lair.mp3. Background: assets/lair.webp. Sir Bartholomew is made of parts: sprites/npcs/barty-eye, barty-claw, barty-head, barty-head-black (beard black when he spots you), barty.
- The Cloak opens the cloak secrets (BACKTRACK.cloak) and counts for 100%. Carrier arrival 23: hoard-corner.

## Boss: barty (hide, then wave)

Arena: room dragon-lair, 3x2 screens. Fixed chirp: radius 3 tiles, stun 0 s (never from the cricket's stats). Tell: tail-tip wiggle + rattle-swish, 1 s (1.2 s in Gentle Mode); emit `game.emit('tell', {x, y})` when it starts. Losing restarts the current phase (restore health). Built for Jump 2 / Speed 2. Reward: cloak.

Layout: 3x2 glass vivarium under a hot orange basking lamp. Hoard piles (coins, buttons, bottle caps, marbles, foil wrappers) rise in steps to the top of the hoard under the lamp. He is far too big: the camera only shows parts (a golden eye in the gloom, a claw, the spiky beard).

- Phase 1: skitter between hoard piles and hide (bottle caps, gaps between coins) while he searches, head-bobbing (his eye sweeps a cone). Chirping gives you away. Reach the second pile tier. Ends: tier 2.
- Phase 2: his claw sweeps the hoard (tell: the claw lifts; 1 s). Duck under bottle caps and into coin gaps; climb toward the lamp. Ends: top of the hoard.
- Phase 3: befriending. Stand on top of the hoard in plain view and wave: hold Listen and press Kick (the slow arm-wave). He stops, waves back, his beard pales. "...Nobody ever waves." Ends: the Cellophane Cloak.

Hide spots: bottle caps (4); coin gaps (5).

Timings: tell 1, eyeSweep 3.

Props: hoard-pile, hoard-buttons, hoard-coins, bottle-cap, marble, candy-wrapper, pebble. Sprites: npcs/barty-eye, npcs/barty-claw, npcs/barty-head, npcs/barty-head-black, npcs/barty. Gecko art: sprites/geckos/barty/ (idle, strike, sleep, body, tail, legs + meta.json; renderer's gecko rig).

Lines: TEXT.geckos.barty.pre (3) before the fight, .post (2) after (TEXT.npcs.barty: meet, search, sweep, wave, after).
Recorded solution: design/solutions/zone-lair-boss.json with the weakest crickets available at that point.
